items.title: How Does Palantir Technologies (PLTR) FedStart Milestone Change Its Federal AI Case?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) supported OLIGO Security in achieving FedRAMP Class D (High) certification through its FedStart program. The FedRAMP Class D (High) authorization represents the highest federal cloud security standard for handling sensitive U.S. government data. OLIGO Security's certified platform can now be used for more security critical workloads by U.S. federal government customers.
